evidence: Closed-form and one-dimensional estimates for the fabric library in materials.py (values and their standing in sources.json) at the shared gravity and the design run's sea-level air, against Earth. Falls use the solver's normal-pressure law; swings add a strip's potential-flow added mass (a Morison-type estimate); turns use a meridian string in still air without air and with skin friction alone (a fold-free skirt), and an upper-bound index of the folds' drag against the centrifugal pull. A screen for choosing fabrics and cuts; the cloth solver's trial runs test it.
